name: PADI AWARE Foundation Community Grant Program
summary: Small grants for grassroots ocean projects by PADI Dive Centers and small non-profits, covering marine protected areas, vulnerable marine species, coral reef recovery, marine debris and the dive industry's carbon footprint.
reporting: Grantees submit an online Project Report on the project's outcomes, due within one month of the project's end.

status.quote: The next round opens in 2027 and dates will be posted here once they are confirmed.

applicant_types.quote: PADI AWARE Foundation is open to funding non-profit ocean conservation-related organizations and/or PADI Dive Centers.

access.quote: All potential applicants will be required to complete an initial Eligibility Quiz.

window.quote: The next round opens in 2027 and dates will be posted here once they are confirmed.

amount.quote: The maximum grant amount is $10,000 USD.

reporting.quote: All grantees are expected, as part of their funding agreement, to provide a Project Report on the outcomes of the agreed upon project at the end of the funding cycle.
